title: Adapting Knowledge Graphs for Behavior Denoising in Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.21243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequential recommendation predicts the next item from a user's interaction history, but not every interaction is equally informative. Real logs combine persistent preferences with temporary needs, exploration, and incidental behavior, so some interactions can distort history representations or provide unreliable supervision. Existing denoising methods judge such interactions mainly from co-occurrence, order, or model predictions, without explicit evidence from relations between items. Knowledge graphs (KGs) offer this evidence, but item popularity, graph degree, uneven coverage, and widely shared entities can inflate connectivity and bias reliability estimates. Here we present AdaptedKG, which derives calibrated KG evidence for each training example without adding graph representations to the recommendation model. It first compares the observed context with structurally matched alternatives to identify relational paths that are unusual

translated_title: 适应知识图谱以在序列推荐中去除行为噪声
translated_abstract: 序列推荐根据用户的交互历史预测下一个项目，但并非每次交互都具有同等信息量。真实日志混合了持久偏好、临时需求、探索行为和偶然行为，因此某些交互可能会扭曲历史表示或提供不可靠的监督。现有的去噪方法主要基于共现、顺序或模型预测来判断此类交互，缺乏项目间关系的明确证据。知识图谱（KGs）提供了这种证据，但项目流行度、图谱度数、覆盖不均以及广泛共享的实体可能夸大连接性并偏置可靠性估计。我们提出了AdaptedKG，它在不向推荐模型添加图表示的情况下，为每个训练样本提取校准的KG证据。它首先将观察到的上下文与结构匹配的替代方案进行比较，以识别不寻常的关系路径。
tldr: 本文提出AdaptedKG方法，利用知识图谱提供的关系证据，通过结构匹配和校准机制去除序列推荐中的行为噪声，无需将图表示融入模型。
en_tdlr: This paper presents AdaptedKG, which leverages knowledge graph relational evidence via structural matching and calibration to denoise behavioral interactions in sequential recommendation, without integrating graph representations into the model.
